issue.title: Bug: T2 changes in everflow tests should be applied to all VoQ switches

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

We were experiencing everflow failures on new DRH topologies on VoQ switch.

This was caused because: T2 specific changes in everflow tests, specifically TTL adjustments and ECMP next hop skip, should be applied to all VoQ switches (not just T2 VoQ)

### Steps to Reproduce

Run tests on a VoQ switch that does not have a T2 toplogy.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Currently the tests will fail, the test should pass if T2 specific changes are applied to VoQ.

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Everflow tests was failing on VoQ switches where topology was not T2.

Also, very minor improvements/cleanup:
- Consolidate nested if t2 and if duthosts > 1
- Add log when successfully validated ACL rules
- Change logging level from ERROR to WARNING when ACL rules are mismatched, because we wait_until it matches, it is not a definitive error
#### How did you do it?
Apply T2-specific test changes to all VoQ switches where appropriate.
#### How did you verify/test it?
Rerun the failing tests and confirm it's passing.
